content.text: You’ve built a plugin that solves a real problem. Designers in Lagos need your Figma templates. Developers in Nairobi want your code snippets. But when you try to sell it, Stripe rejects your application. PayPal flags your account. Gumroad blocks your country. The platforms you’re told to rely on exclude you by design. This isn’t an accident. It’s a structural problem baked into the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-one-afternoon-fast-2|Payment Gateways]] processors themselves. Their compliance teams blacklist entire regions based on risk models that don’t apply to your reality. The solution isn’t another workaround. It’s a permanent shift to sovereign commerce infrastructure—a stack you own, control, and deploy without intermediaries. This is how you sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-14|COREMERCH guide to payments]]-explained-digital-creators-8|digital]] products without renting access to someone else’s platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Plugins online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-hosted stack that replaces payment processors, hosting platforms, and delivery systems with tools you control. It’s not a plugin or a SaaS product. It’s a combination of open components—GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. These tools don’t care where you’re from. They don’t flag your transactions based on your IP address. They don’t freeze your funds because your country is on a watchlist. The stack is deployed to your own GitHub or Cloudflare account. You own the code. You own the data. You own the revenue stream. When a customer buys your plugin, payment is verified on-chain, the file is delivered from your storage, and the order is logged in your database—all without a third party touching the process. This is infrastructure sovereignty: the ability to conduct commerce on your terms, using tools that cannot be taken away.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the flow: A customer lands on your GitHub Pages site, hosted for free. They select your plugin and pay using NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC. The payment hits the blockchain, and NOWPayments’ webhook fires the moment it confirms—usually within seconds. Cloudflare Workers, your backend, receives the webhook, verifies the payment, and generates a secure download link for your plugin. The order details are logged in Supabase, your database, and the file is served from Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, your storage. No platform skims a percentage. No processor freezes your account. The entire process is automated, transparent, and yours. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, pre-configured with SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability and end-to-end tested to ensure every component works seamlessly. You get a fully operational store without writing a line of code.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re selling plugins, templates, or software in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or Pakistan, you’ve already hit the walls Stripe and PayPal put up. Your customers are global, but your ability to collect payment is not. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves this by removing the middleman. It’s for creators who want to own their stack, not rent it. Who want to control their data, not hand it to a platform. Who want to build a business that cannot be shut down by a compliance team’s algorithm. The Edge Commerce Stack is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe—a market where currency collapse and financial isolation are the norm. If it works there, it works anywhere.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure replaces platforms with tools you own.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages hosts your storefront for free, with custom domains and SSL included. Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic, from payment verification to file delivery, without server costs. Supabase provides a Postgres database to store orders, customer data, and product inventory. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a flat 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhooks. Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive stores your plugin files, delivering them securely via signed URLs. Each component is free or low-cost, with no hidden fees or revenue sharing. The Edge Commerce Stack integrates these tools into a cohesive system, pre-configured and deployed to your accounts. You get lifetime access to the infrastructure, with no subscriptions or platform lock-in. The stack is yours to modify, scale, or relocate as needed.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your requirements: What products are you selling? What cryptocurrencies will you accept? Where will you store customer data? The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) handles this for you, deploying a fully functional store in 48 hours with 5 products pre-loaded. If you prefer to build it yourself, begin with hosting—set up GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure NOWPayments for your chosen cryptocurrencies (BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees). Connect Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic and Supabase to store orders. Test the flow end-to-end: Simulate a purchase, verify the payment webhook, and ensure the file delivers correctly. Once live, monitor performance and scale as needed. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation and source code if you want to DIY. Either way, the goal is the same: Own your infrastructure, own your business.

It’s built for creators who want to own their stack, not rent it. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free, SSL-included storefronts. 2. Set up payments: NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification with 0.5% fees. 3. Configure backend logic: Cloudflare Workers to handle payment webhooks and file delivery. 4. Store orders: Supabase or Google Sheets for logging transactions and customer data. 5. Deliver files: Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive with signed URLs for secure downloads. 6. Test end-to-end: Simulate purchases to ensure payments, delivery, and logging work seamlessly. 7. Deploy: Push the stack to your own accounts—no platform access required.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’ve never coded before?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is pre-configured and deployed for you. If you prefer to DIY, the Sovereign Blueprint provides step-by-step documentation and full source code.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept?
Start with low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON. NOWPayments supports 300+ coins, so you can add more as needed.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually by sending crypto back to the customer’s wallet. The system logs all transactions, so you can verify purchases before issuing a refund.
Is this secure?
Yes. Payments are verified on-chain, files are delivered via signed URLs, and data is stored in your own database. No sensitive information is exposed to third parties.
What if I want to scale?
The stack is designed to scale. Upgrade your hosting, add more products, or integrate additional tools as your business grows. You own the infrastructure, so the limits are yours to set.
Crypto payments, free hosting, and automated delivery—no intermediaries required.
